facts.text: Melanie's wedding was described as full of love and joy, with everyone they love present to celebrate them.

evidence.quote: It was amazing, Caroline. The day was full of love and joy. Everyone we love was there to celebrate us - it was really special.

facts.text: Melanie's favorite part of their wedding was marrying their partner and promising to be together forever.

evidence.quote: Marrying my partner and promising to be together forever was the best part.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that flowers were an important part of their wedding decor and reminded them of that day.

evidence.quote: They were an important part of my wedding decor and always remind me of that day.
